ruling.recommended_action: Refund $6.83 to the rider as a Ryde voucher for the unexcused 4.84 km detour on this RydeTAXI trip; no account flag warranted (driver has 0 prior upheld disputes).

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 21:56–22:03 adds 4.84 km (up to 1176 m from the optimal route). RD-4(a) fails: the F12 accident was reported 21:57, after the segment started at 21:56, and describes AYE congestion rather than a closure of this segment's optimal-route portion; RD-4(b) bands (F10 band 5, F11 band 4) are moderate and cannot exempt alone. No RD-5 consent: chats F7/F8 contain no route discussion pre-dating 21:56. Segment is unexempt under RD-1 and refunded per RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's 'unavoidable accident detour' claim is contradicted by the traffic record: the accident was reported at 21:57, after the detour began at 21:56 [F3], so it cannot justify leaving the optimal route; system records (traffic/gps/timeline) override the driver statement [F12][F3].
